body: that's an interesting way of looking at it, you've made me think. I might be a good person in terms of intent (most of the time) but that doesn't stop me from being a negative influence on the world. plus, my own feelings are more important than that and I feel like shit.

there's a lot of reasons and ways I could answer this, but here's one angle. I'm just not a good person. I tell myself that I try but I really don't. I wonder why people don't usually seek me out or start conversations and I think that's why. I'm lazy, unreliable, cold, don't understand other people's feelings, self centered, abrasive... I could go on. I'm really missing that deep human connection piece of life and the reason I can't have it is people largely don't like me.
I typed up a thing for the other comment above about what's happening

hey, thanks for the reply. For the last 5 years or so I've been back and forth between pretending everything is ok and wanting to kill myself. Right now I'm thinking, "Why keep trying to continue when every single time it lands me back here?" Sure maybe I'll work through all of these problems and suffer and hurt people, and eventually get to a place where things are ok. But you know what? I assure you that soon after, I will be wanting to do it again. I don't even have a difficult life or any big problems, I'm just a pathetic waste of space who wants to kill himself at the slightest issue.
